evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/g/b carries plugin name 'Item ID Search', config group 'itemsearch', description 'Enable the Item ID Search Panel' and panel tag.

On startup it resolves rs/s/g/a, initializes the panel, loads search.png, creates a navigation button titled 'Item ID Search' at priority 6 and adds it to the client toolbar; shutdown removes the same navigation button.
The sole plugin image resource is search.png and the sole owned presentation surface is the Item ID Search panel.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name from the preserved plugin descriptor and lifecycle; no public source identity was found.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/g/a extends the plugin-panel base, owns a search JTextField, read-only results JTextArea and JScrollPane, and lays them out with a Search button.

The panel enforces a minimum three-character query, requires the item database and logged-in client state, scans the live item-definition table by case-insensitive name and renders matching item IDs/names/noted state.
The exact warning strings are 'Please have at least 3 letters in your search term!', 'Please login before searching items!' and 'Please wait until the client has loaded the item database!'.
